## 🚀 Feature Summary
<!-- One sentence describing the feature -->

## Problem / Motivation
<!-- What problem does this solve? Who benefits from it? -->

## Proposed Solution
<!-- Describe your ideal solution. Be as specific as possible. -->

## Alternative Solutions Considered
<!-- Any other approaches you thought about? Why did you reject them? -->

## UI / UX Mockup (optional)
<!-- Sketch, screenshot, or Figma link if it's a visual feature -->

## Additional Context
<!-- Any other information — related issues, similar features in other apps, etc. -->

- [ ] Yes, I'd like to submit a PR for this
- [ ] No, just suggesting
